finding.headline: "The Taxi-Mum Hack"
finding.problem: "We don't own a car. Every clinic trip is a taxi. The driver won't have a baby seat. I've been holding my newborn in my arms in traffic. What do I buy that I can carry and click in anywhere?"
finding.person: Lagos/diaspora mum who uses taxis/buses (no family car), needs a lightweight car seat she can carry and install in a stranger's vehicle.
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Angle / Module (this is a very real Lagos pain — see Pulse Nigeria transport reality).". Verdict: PASSES (5/5).
